0022600036.text: The Miami Heat (5-6, 1-3 at home, second in the Southeast and 1.5 games back) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (6-6, 2-4 on the road, second in the Central and 2 games back) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, with Miami riding a two-game winning streak and Cleveland on a one-game streak. Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo (wrist), Klay Thompson (ankle) and Pelle Larsson (illness) are all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Cleveland is without Sam Merrill (elbow), who is out. The teams split their 2-2 season series in 2025-26, when Cleveland beat Miami 149-128 in Cleveland on March 27, 2026, and they have not yet met in 2026-27.
